text: Granddaughter, 2 months old. 39.2. Nappy has been bone dry since about 8 this morning, it's now gone 9 at night. She has dark skin so I looked at her palms, soles and inside her mouth. Small purplish dots on her feet and on the roof of her mouth. Pressed a glass on the foot ones and they don't go away. Tell me straight what we do.
